svg.text: Two UPN 140 channels 479 mm, webs 104 mm apart, flanges out. Deck

svg.text: 479 x 440 x 6 mm welded on top; jack pad 200 x 104 x 20 mm between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the webs at the bottom, in the middle (the ram pushes here).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sleeves: four 10 mm plates each, 121 x 121 mm outside, 150 mm tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded round a real upright wrapped in 0.5 mm shim, then slid off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld to the channel ends with the uprights 600 mm apart in a jig,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sleeve bottom 20 mm below the channels.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring lugs: 30 x 160 x 8 mm under the bottom flanges at 190 mm each

svg.text: side, 12 mm hole. Rails: four 30 x 15 mm bars 510 mm long, at 60 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 220 mm behind; end stop 400 x 15 x 40 mm across the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
